newsitem.title: USA: Tokheim chosen by Royal Dutch in E. Africa.
newsitem.headline: Tokheim chosen by Royal Dutch in E. Africa.

text.p: Tokheim Corp said Thursday it has been chosen by Kenya Shell Ltd, representing all participating Royal Dutch/Shell Group operating units in its East Africa region, to provide fuel dispensing equipment for three years.

The value of agreement, which covers an area comprising Kenya, Ethiopia, Sudan, Uganda, Ghana, Nigeria and Eritrea, is estimated at about $8 million over the three-year period, a company spokesman said.

Tokheim was selected by Shell in April to supply exclusively the Asia Pacific region initially in Hong Kong, Malaysia, Pakistan, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand. This agreement was later expanded to cover Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, Australia, New Zealand and India.

In 1993 Tokheim was selected by Shell Europe as exclusive supplier in 12 European countries, which was subsequently extended to 20 countries. Tokheim's United Kingdom subsidiary had previously been selected to provide Shell's equipment needs in Britain.
Tokheim designs, makes and services electronic and mechanical petroleum dispensing equipment.
